Title: Overwrite warning — same full name confirms BEFORE anything is written (unused asset)
Section: Asset Library Picker
Preconditions: Admin logged in; Page Builder Asset Library reachable for @td(STORE_PRIMARY.id); fixtures generated once via 'npm run td:gen:cms-uploads' (writes test-data/cms/uploads-5725/); a fresh LOWERCASE working folder created for the case and removed in Cleanup; MANDATORY (2026-09-10): load the shell with a cache-busting query param, e.g. '?storeId=<id>&cb=<new value>'. The shell's index.html is served with NO Cache-Control, so a browser that visited before a deploy keeps executing the PRE-FIX bundle — no preflight request is issued and the file is overwritten silently, which reads exactly like the defect this feature prevents. Before judging any assertion, confirm a same-name upload issues 'GET /api/assets?folderUrl=...&keyword=<filename>' before any write; if that request is absent you are on a cached bundle, not a broken build.
